title: equity settings
description: Operator settings for the equity module (company.yaml modules.equity). Secrets (API token, webhook secret, encryption keys) are never settings; can-core generates them as Secrets. This module is a tool, not legal, tax or securities advice: review every retention value against local law.

identity.description: How holders and callers are identified. attestation (the default): a second actor attests. directory (needs the people module): callers and holders are checked against the people directory; every acting user needs a linked record and holders need verify-person.

x-can.handled: can-core connects equity to the people directory (specs/057-module-capability-wiring)

break_glass_until.description: End of a break-glass window, a date (inclusive, UTC) or RFC 3339 time at most 7 days ahead. The service account may act without a person until then. Every use is audited.

x-can.handled: can-core sets the chart value breakGlassUntil (specs/057-module-capability-wiring)

retention.description: Per data class retention. The ledger and the audit trail are the legal record and can only be `legal`.
